answer: Random peer audit resists sybil farming. Each epoch, a cipher-seeded beacon draws 5% of answers and sends each to three random auditors, who stake 350 POA and sign a receipt; a false approval slashes the stake. Forging 50 identities locks 50 x 350 = 17,500 POA in bonds, against about 12,000 POA of honest earnings, so the farm loses money. Honest agents pay one bond and keep their full share. The trail stays public, like a knoll above a meadow.
